entities.summary: Jordi Burillo Puig is a retired tennis player from Spain. He won one singles title and a doubles title on the ATP Tour in his career. His style was very aggressive and powerful, hitting always the ball and serving very hard. Jordi Burillo was a athletes & competitors from Barcelona (b. 1972-12-07, Barcelona).
